Question Choices: If a polynomial has real coefficients and 2+5i is a root what other root must occur?
Hints: Nonreal roots of real polynomials occur in conjugate pairs.|Change the sign of the imaginary part.
Solution: For real coefficients, every nonreal root occurs with its complex conjugate and the same multiplicity. Nonreal roots therefore use an even part of the total degree; the remaining real-root count, including multiplicity, has the same parity as the degree. The conjugate root 2-5i must also occur.
